acceptance: Exported structured data validates against its schema and contains the facts needed for every current generated query, compat and tuning output; counts are measured at the pinned revision, never fixed at 1,250.
Two exports at identical pinned inputs are byte-identical; reference SQL/DataFrame/error/variant inputs are verified against core APIs.
Existing generator tests and focused exporter tests pass; rendering remains with old generators until the parity and import gates.
context: Delivered in merged PR #3376: scripts/export_docs_data.py + quality/docs-data.schema.json; deterministic (two exports byte-identical, --check drift), 19 focused tests. Measured at that revision: 1149 queries in 22 benchmarks, 575 compat rules, 30 tuning platforms. Python generators retained. TypeScript rendering parity is a separate gate, not verified here.
description:
Description: Add exporters in core that produce structured JSON for the generated pages: per query (id, slug, label, display name, description, groups, representative SQL for the reference dialect and available dialect renderings, DataFrame renderings, source-file link target, TPC notices, seed-driven flags), per benchmark metadata (display name, overview slug, grouping, bucket size), compat rule inventory, and the tuning platform support matrix inputs. The JSON must carry everything the Python markdown generators currently print so a TypeScript generator needs no Python. Add `--check` drift tests. Do not delete the Python generators yet.
Verification: validate deterministic JSON against its schema; exercise real query catalog and compare exported content to the existing generator inputs. Do not create a second permanent Python Markdown renderer just to prove the exporter. The TypeScript/Python output parity gate supplies end-to-end rendering proof.
